why: A (universes 0): for a geodesic of a slice submanifold N ⊆ V on an OPEN set s: d/dt‖γ'‖² = 0, constant speed on preconnected s, length of γ on [a,b] ⊆ s is ‖γ'(t₀)‖(b − a), and t ↦ γ(at + b) is a geodesic on the preimage (affine reparametrization). B: for a geodesic of a Levi-Civita connection on an abstract ℝⁿ-manifold on any interval: constant speed r, signed arc length r(t − t₀), and t ↦ c(kt) a geodesic on {t | kt ∈ s}. A ⇒ B fails genuinely: the abstract proof needs abstract Lemma 8.3 (d/dt⟨V,W⟩ = ⟨DV/dt,W⟩ + ⟨V,DW/dt⟩ from Milnor-compatibility) and the chain rule for D/dt along reparametrized curves on abstract manifolds — absent (A's proofs use the ambient V). B ⇒ A fails: B does not specialize to N ⊆ V (no packaging of the induced connection as a Mathlib CovariantDerivative/RiemannianBundle); A's affine reparametrization t ↦ at+b and open-set (non-interval) domains are also beyond B.
embedded_special_case_note: Items/V7_2.lean: B_emb := B for M = Bridge.Sub hN (↥N, model ℝⁿ, induced metric, ConnectedSpace) and cov = Bridge.conn (B_to_B_emb). Not covered by B_emb: the translation t ↦ γ(t + b) in comp_mul_add (not in Milnor's statement). Limitation: only the induced connection.
